definitions: A feeling of reassurance and relaxation following the release from anxiety or distress.
The alleviation of pain, distress, or discomfort.
Financial or practical assistance given to those in need.
A method of moulding, carving, or stamping in which the design stands out from the surface.
A person or group of people replacing others on duty.
The variations in elevation of an area of land.
examples: I felt a great sense of relief.
The sculpture was in high relief.
The relief arrived at six o'clock.
The map showed the relief of the mountains.
